summary: wait_for_connection waits until Ansible can connect and run ping/win_ping on the host, retrying within a total timeout; works with Windows.
questions: How do I wait until a newly built VM is reachable by Ansible?
What's the difference between wait_for and wait_for_connection?

answer_card.title: Wait until a host is usable
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.wait_for_connection` retries Ansible's real transport and runs `ping`/`win_ping` until it succeeds or `timeout` passes. Unlike `wait_for`, it confirms end-to-end Ansible usability. Works on Windows.
